item.title: Manatsu no Yoru no Yume
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Sun West
  • 発売日: 2000-04-21
  • スコア: なし (2 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 真夏の夜の夢
  • 英語名: Manatsu no Yoru no Yume

别名

  • THE NIGHT DREAM OF THE MIDSUMMER

あらすじ

I’d been having nightmares for an entire month, and it was even starting to affect my autonomic nervous system. That’s when a woman calling herself a messenger from the “Mansion of Dreams” suddenly appeared. She said she came from the world of the nightmares that had been plaguing me.
